name: Opportunity
overview: Scripture reveals that opportunity is intimately connected to recognizing God's sovereignty and responding to His call. Psalms 100:3 reminds us that we belong to the Lord, who made us and cares for us as a shepherd does his sheep. Proverbs 1:24-28 warns that rejecting God's invitations and counsel leads to a loss of opportunity, resulting in calamity and unanswered pleas. Thus, the measure of responsibility in opportunity lies in heeding God's call promptly and faithfully.
